description_for_human: Free MCP server for AI agents — check domain availability, compare prices across 6 registrars, look up full WHOIS/RDAP intel, and estimate domain value.
description_for_model: Donadomains exposes a free Model Context Protocol server over the Streamable HTTP transport. Connect from any MCP-aware client (Claude Desktop, Claude.ai web Connectors, Cursor, Continue, Windsurf, Zed) by URL https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp. Tools: check_domain_availability(domain) returns availability + price OR full ownership info; search_domains(keyword, limit?, tldFilter?, includeTaken?) returns available domains with prices across GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Porkbun; get_domain_info(domain) returns WHOIS/RDAP/DNS intel for any TLD including RDAP-less ccTLDs like .sh, .io, .ac via port-43 WHOIS; valuate_domain(domain, registered?, isPremium?, registrationPrice?) returns AI-powered USD valuation with reasoning. Free, no API key, rate-limited per IP (IPv6 normalized to /64).
